subject: Renewal & capacity uplift coordination — BetaHealth (BH-4872)
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rodriguez <elena@betahealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Feb 2028 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal & capacity uplift coordination — BetaHealth (BH-4872)

Hi Elena —

Quick kickoff note to align on BetaHealth's upcoming renewal and the proposed capacity uplift. High level: the current term ends 2028-05-31, BetaHealth is looking to add ~25% peak throughput for Q3 and extend term to 12 months. We want to lock timeline, stakeholders, and an initial QBR slot so procurement has time for PO/redlines.

Proposed timeline (tentative):
- Week of 02/21 — QBR and technical capacity review (60–90m)
- Week of 02/28 — Commercial alignment and draft SOW sent
- Week of 03/13 — Procurement redlines/PO expected
- Target go-live for uplift: 2028-04-01 (soft) / 2028-05-01 (full)

Request from your side: please confirm (1) who from Procurement and Engineering should join the QBR, (2) whether the 25% uplift sounds right or if you need a sizing call, and (3) any constraints on contract term (e.g., auto-renew, invoicing cadence). I attached the current MAAP/usage appendix for reference (BetaHealth_MAAP_v2.pdf).

If helpful, here are two QBR windows I can offer (PST):
- Tue 02/22, 10:00–11:30
- Wed 02/23, 14:00–15:30

Thanks — looking to keep this lightweight and actionable.

— Aditya
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachment: BetaHealth_MAAP_v2.pdf (usage appendix)

Date: Tue, 14 Feb 2028 13:04:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Renewal & capacity uplift coordination — BetaHealth (BH-4872)

Thanks Aditya — appreciate the clear timeline. We are aligned on the need to increase capacity ahead of our Q3 ramp.

Quick answers:
- Procurement lead: Mike Chen (copied).
- Engineering: Elena + 1 infra manager (I'll confirm name by EOD 2/15).
- The 25% uplift is the right order of magnitude; we may want a short sizing call to validate peak slots.

For the QBR windows, Wed 02/23 14:00–15:30 PST works best for our team. Can you send a calendar invite with the agenda and attendees? Procurement prefers to see any pricing changes and draft SOW ahead of the meeting.

Also tagging procurement@betahealth.com for PO timeline visibility.

Elena Rodriguez

elena@betahealth.com

Date: Wed, 15 Feb 2028 08:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal & capacity uplift coordination — BetaHealth (BH-4872)

Looping in a commercial note before we send the invite/agenda.

Commercial posture suggestions:
- 12-month renewal, term start aligned to current contract end (2028-06-01) but with uplift effective 2028-04-01 as a bridge (we'll provide interim capacity credits).
- For +25% throughput, recommend the "Growth" pricing bracket (10% list uplift) — with an early-commit discount if they sign within 30 days (additional 3% off).
- If procurement asks for invoicing cadence: offer quarterly invoicing or annual prepay (3% discount on annual).

Risks/notes for QBR agenda:
- Validate traffic profile (burst vs sustained) — if bursty, we should discuss burst pool sizing and dedicated buffer.
- Security/compliance ask: BetaHealth previously requested additional logging retention — ensure we surface any incremental costs.

I attached the draft SOW stub we've used as a template (Signed_SOW_stub.pdf) and pushed the deal to HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/4872.

— Monica
Monica Patel
Sr. Renewals Manager, Redwood Inference
monica@redwood.com

2) 30m — Capacity sizing and uplift plan (operations + infra)

- Procurement: if possible, share standard PO terms they require (Mike/procurement@betahealth.com).

Decisions made in the meeting:
- QBR accepted proposed uplift of ~25% (BetaHealth wants a short sizing pilot on 3/15).
- Procurement will send a first-pass redline to Aditya by EOD 02/28; Mike will own timeline.
- BetaHealth engineering will provide detailed traffic slices by 02/25.

Next asks from BetaHealth: please send the draft SOW and pricing slide deck to procurement and myself (elena@betahealth.com) so Mike can start the PO workflow. We attached our internal PO request form for your reference (PO_Request_Form.pdf).

We'll aim to have a signed agreement by mid-March if redlines are small.
